saved_dungeons_material_metadata.formula: max((sRGBDecode(auxiliary.rgb).b * Emissive * EmissivePower + sRGBDecode(albedo.rgb) * NaturalEmissive) * DeathEmissive, 0)

texture_srgb.provenance: SRGB is absent in both original texture packages; UE texture parser default is true

static_defaults.game_time_domain: time >= 0; no active runtime damage/enchantment/selection override

preview.surface_lighting: Blockbench studio light; not original scene lighting
preview.note: Only the static linear emissive equation is ported from DXBC. Preview tone mapping and scene light are explicitly separate.
preview.material_limit: Original static emissive equation ported; original specular/roughness sampling and full game lighting are not represented by the Blockbench studio surface light.

saved_dungeons_material_metadata.preservation: Original albedo and auxiliary PNG bytes embedded unchanged; no emission baked into albedo; HDR parameters remain floating point.

material_metadata_checks.rendering_scope: Metadata/source verification only. This audit does not execute the preview shader or certify full Unreal shading.

original_uv_coverage.method: UV0 triangle-cell positive-area intersection, unioned per original quad so its diagonal is not counted as reuse; also reports texel-center sampling. Atlas clipped to [0,64]^2, no unverified wrap extrapolation.
original_uv_coverage.padding_caveat: Edge-connected opaque black is an operational padding-candidate class, not a proven material-use semantic. Never force every atlas pixel onto geometry.
original_uv_coverage.original_reuse_conclusion: Any overlap or unused texels reported here occur in the original Verdant mesh UVs. Do not change original UVs to force complete atlas usage or artificial uniqueness.

conditional_assembly_status: Original-player bind assembly with actual Verdant Blueprint component TRS; native GearActor Paperdoll skeletal assignment and runtime/reference image pose remain unproven. Omitted fields use explicit standard native defaults.
nonuniform_scale_preservation: Original Blueprint component TRS are baked in each original vertex; scalar scales are not substituted. The component matrix was independently reconstructed by UE Euler matrix products.
geometry_acceptance: Coordinates, original UV0, source triangle order and rigid binding are compared directly. Floating-point residuals and Euler normalization differences remain explicit.
limits: Normals, tangents and UV1 are exact in source sidecar; native importer does not consume them.
Original StaticMesh has no skin weights. Weight 1 is the derived rigid attachment to the actual Blueprint socket/bone.
Assembly uses original player binary inverse bind and actual component TRS; native Paperdoll skeletal assignment and reference-image runtime pose remain unproven.
Omitted native component fields use explicitly documented standard defaults, not measured values.
This file-only audit does not measure native bind deformation, animation, lighting, bloom, exposure, roughness or game runtime.

Both original PNGs and static emissive metadata are verified, but metadata is not proof of executing the complete original shader. Effective switches use native compiled evidence, not all .props observations.
